tasks: Load persisted diagnosis report and validate workflow/model-call binding
Resolve each supporting/counter Evidence through tenant/Incident scoped store and validate Artifact integrity/expiry
Re-evaluate evidence sufficiency with deterministic Gate
For a proposal, inspect exact proposal/Policy review snapshot and observe pending Approval without deciding it
success_rule: Every required task has observed success; missing records, mismatched fingerprints, unavailable stores, expired Evidence and unresolved citations fail rather than being inferred
timing_scope: Local scripted backend review only, not human comprehension, UI usability, active labor or incident MTTR
semantic_quality: Use the separately isolated diagnosis scoring track; deterministic resolvability does not prove semantic root-cause correctness
publication_rule: Always label simulated; no conversion to human time saved or human approval success; report raw denominators and failures
